newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds underperform bloc partners.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds underperform bloc partners.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads closed sharply wider to its dollar bloc partners following a slide in the Australian dollar and after the Reserve Bank left monetary policy unchanged.
Today's third quarter GDP report also received mixed reviews and saw the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread blow out above 100 basis points again.
Chris Caton, chief economist at BT Australia said it was possible for the local 10-year bond yield to breach 7.0 percent, but he felt such a move would not be sustained.

"(And) the differential with the U.S. has narrowed as much as it going to. There must be the risk that (U.S.) bonds sell off eventually, and all of the good news on inflation will get priced in in Australian bonds," he added.
U.S. Treasuries were little changed in Tokyo trading.
